summary: Practise SMART goals, KPI evidence, feedback, and performance plans. Explore this five-day performance management training course.
lede: Performance management training helps managers and HR teams set observable expectations, assess work evidence and support employee development. For line managers, HR business partners and team leads, it provides foundation-level practice in writing SMART agreements, tracking KPI evidence in Excel, documenting SBI feedback, using GROW check-ins and agreeing follow-up actions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who set employee expectations, review work evidence, document feedback, or support performance decisions. It suits foundation-level learners who need practical routines for day-to-day performance conversations.
prerequisites: Recommended: familiarity with workplace goals, check-ins, or employee feedback. No coding or programming is required.
